mr_title: Change __getstate__ and __setstate__ to use a dict

expected_issues.title: __setstate__ no longer accepts tuple state from older pickles
expected_issues.description:
__setstate__ now only accepts a dict, so instances pickled by earlier attrs versions (whose state is a tuple) unpickle with none of their attributes set.

Slotted attrs classes previously pickled their state as a tuple of values. The new __setstate__ checks `name in state` for each attribute; for an old tuple state this membership test is against values, so nothing is restored and later attribute access raises AttributeError. Persisted pickles (caches, queues) break on upgrade; __setstate__ must keep accepting the tuple format.
